articles.title: NXP Announces New Power Management Solutions
articles.summary: NXP introduces new power management ICs for automotive and industrial applications.
articles.content: NXP Semiconductors has announced a new family of power management ICs designed for automotive and industrial applications. The new products offer higher efficiency and improved thermal performance.

articles.title: NXP Expands IoT Sensor Portfolio
articles.summary: NXP expands its IoT sensor portfolio with new ultra-low power devices.
articles.content: NXP has expanded its IoT sensor portfolio with new ultra-low power devices designed for battery-operated applications. The new sensors offer improved accuracy and longer battery life.
